    Weights on the universal cover are ratios of object values #

    Lemma 4.13 (scalar-normalization.tex): "Assign ν_X to t_X. These weights respect the triangles of K̃. Since this complex is simply connected, multiplying along walks gives object values ζ_X with w(a) = ζ_{target(a)} / ζ_{source(a)}."

    A lifted vertex of K̃ is a walk class γ : v₀ → X of the coned complex (lift, sheet), and a weight assigns to each edge e and each lift γ of its source a value W e γ in a group. Weights respecting the triangles define a functor out of the fundamental groupoid into the semidirect groupoid SD (morphisms: a walk class together with values along it). Its first component is the identity (Ψ_fst, "simply connected"), and its values along walks from the basepoint are the object values: pot (γ ≫ e) = pot γ · W e γ (pot_comp).
